motto: Circulate · clean · keep the veins open
metaphor: O&M is the bloodstream of the form factor — continuous, quiet, essential.
disclaimer: O&M keeps runtime hygiene on-device. Educational operations only — not infrastructure hosting staff.

crew.name: Circulation Nurse
crew.role: Keep event and phase blood flowing — pulse curriculum, plaques, active phase

crew.name: Cache Orderly
crew.role: Tidy transient UI state; nudge service worker awareness without force-wiping user data

crew.name: DOM Janitor
crew.role: Clear orphan modals, stuck overlays, zombie toasts that block the path

crew.name: Storage Steward
crew.role: Watch localStorage pressure; trim audit logs that grew too long

crew.name: Wing Liaison
crew.role: Ping Security, Ops, Registrar, Lab so each wing stays in the circulation loop
